item.title: Εξεταστική για τον ΟΠΕΚΕΠΕ: Εγκρίθηκε κατά πλειοψηφία το πόρισμα της ΝΔ – «Πλυντήριο ευθυνών και συγκάλυψη» καταγγέλλει η αντιπολίτευση
item.description: Εγκρίθηκε κατά πλειοψηφία το πόρισμα της Νέας Δημοκρατίας για την Εξεταστική Επιτροπή σχετικά με τον ΟΠΕΚΕΠΕ, με την αντιπολίτευση να αντιδρά έντονα κάνοντας λόγο για συγκάλυψη. Ο εισηγητής της ΝΔ Μακάριος Λαζαρίδης υποστήριξε ότι «το πρόβλημα αποδείχθηκε βαθύ και διαχρονικό» και πως «δεν προέκυψαν αποχρώσες ενδείξεις ποινικής ευθύνης», κατηγορώντας τα κόμματα της αντιπολίτευσης ότι διατηρούν «τεχνητά την ένταση» και επενδύουν σε «σκανδαλολογία». item.title: Tempi anniversary: Students write victims’ names in red outside parliament
item.description: A rally by university and school students in central Athens to mark the third anniversary of the Tempi tragedy has concluded. When the march reached parliament, students wrote the names of the 57 victims in red paint on the ground outside the building. Διαβάστε εδώ ⇛

item.title: Predator wiretapping trial: Four convicted without mitigation as court orders further criminal inquiries
item.description: All four defendants in the Predator wiretapping trial were found guilty without any mitigating circumstances, the presiding judge of the Single-Member Misdemeanour Court said. The court convicted Giannis Lavranos, Felix Biggio, and the couple Tal Jonathan Dillian and Sarah Alexandra Hamou, businessmen whose companies are linked to the malware. item.title: ‘Did they act alone?’ Opposition presses government after wiretapping convictions
item.description: Opposition parties launched a coordinated attack on the government immediately after the conviction of the four defendants in the Predator wiretapping scandal, demanding that Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis and his government answer for their relationship with those found guilty. item.title: Εξώδικο του Γρ. Δημητριάδη στον Αλ. Τσίπρα για την ανάρτησή του για την καταδίκη των 4 του Predator – «Δεν θα σιωπήσω, αναμένω τις αγωγές σας», απαντά
item.description: Ο Γρηγόρης Δημητριάδης, πρώην γενικός γραμματέας του Πρωθυπουργού και θείου του, Κυριάκου Μητσοτάκη, αντέδρασε με εξώδικο στις δηλώσεις του Αλέξη Τσίπρα για το σκάνδαλο των υποκλοπών, μετά την απόφαση του δικαστηρίου που καταδίκασε τους 4 του Predator σε 126 χρόνια. Ο Τσίπρας είχε αναφερθεί στις βαριές ποινές που επιβλήθηκαν στους κατηγορούμενους και κατηγόρησε τον Δημητριάδη και τον Κυριάκο Μητσοτάκη για «ηθικούς και εκτελεστικούς αυτουργούς» των υποκλοπών και της συγκάλυψής τους. item.title: Inquiry report on Greece’s farm subsidy agency scandal approved as opposition cries cover-up
item.description: The proposal submitted by New Democracy MPs was approved by a majority as the findings of parliament’s inquiry committee into OPEKEPE, the Greek agency responsible for administering EU farm subsidies. In line with parliament’s rules of procedure (article 148), the report will include the views of the minority. Διαβάστε εδώ ⇛

item.title: Evros on red alert as four embankments fail and river stays near peak
item.description: The situation in Evros remains precarious after four embankments broke, pushing water levels higher as authorities struggle to shore up defences. More than 150,000 acres have been flooded and farmers are already counting severe losses. Διαβάστε εδώ ⇛

item.title: ‘Maximum pressure’: How Washington is squeezing Cuba’s energy lifeline
item.description: Cuba is facing its most serious challenge since the fall of the USSR, as the United States tightens its blockade against the island, following the kidnapping of Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro. Διαβάστε εδώ ⇛

item.title: PM’s nephew serves legal notice on former prime minister over wiretapping claims
item.description: Grigoris Dimitriadis, former secretary general of the prime minister’s office and nephew of Kyriakos Mitsotakis, has reacted with an out-of-court notice to statements made by former prime minister Alexis Tsipras on the wiretapping scandal, following a court decision that sentenced the four defendants in the Predator spyware case to 126 years. item.title: Chevron deal sparks backlash over offshore drilling plans south of Crete and the Peloponnese
item.description: During the week, the Greek state signed an agreement with the Chevron and HELLENiQ ENERGY consortium granting exclusive rights to explore for and exploit hydrocarbons in sea areas south of the Peloponnese and Crete. The move was greeted by celebratory headlines in parts of the media, framed as a government success and a deepening of ties with the United States. Διαβάστε εδώ ⇛
